adjudication_20260803.governance_score: YELLOW - one notch below kill-grade. Scored against the patterns honestly: on IPS.PA's mechanical bar (2+ exec-committee exits within 6 months) Kalmar FIRES - 3 LT exits announced Mar-30/Apr-28/Jul-31, all effective by Dec-31. But the pattern CONTENT differs decisively from both comparators: IPS was GROUP-CEO-level churn (2 CEOs in 10 months, a removal, an information vacuum, targets at risk) - Kalmar's CEO is unchanged and 2 of 3 exits have named successors + overlap periods; VRT's tell was DISCLOSURE DISCONTINUATION (orders/backlog pulled while the narrative stayed bullish) - Kalmar still publishes full order/order-book data, honesty CLEAN, no MAR insider sales. The genuinely ambiguous datum: a 20-year veteran division president 'has resigned' with NO successor two months before a CMD - consistent with strategy disagreement over Counterbalanced's role in the Nov-2 portfolio story OR normal year-2 post-spin resorting; not distinguishable today. NOT great-man-style (no single irreplaceable operator; family anchor 69% + institutional depth). Verdict: concentrated continuity risk in exactly the H2 window the hockey-stick guide must land in = a real size argument, not a kill.
adjudication_20260803.guide_math: FY guide 'comparable operating profit margin above 12.5%'. H1: 12.4% on EUR899.3M = EUR111.3M. Required H2 margin is ~12.6-12.7% ALMOST REGARDLESS of H2 sales level (m2 = 12.5% + [0.125x899.3 - 111.3]/S2 ~ 12.5% + 1.1/S2): at H2 sales = H1 -> 12.63%; at H2 -5% -> 12.63%. So the guide needs ~+25bp H/H acceleration against: Q2 12.4% vs 13.1% PY (decelerating YoY), Driving Excellence 98% banked (EUR49M of ~50M - the incremental tailwind is full-period flow-through of already-secured savings, not new savings), ongoing tariff drag, order book -4% w/ Q2 sales +14% via drawdown (harder H2 comps), and the JUN3/KION cross-read showing PRICE COMPETITION in the adjacent capex complex. CREDIBLE-BUT-NOT-BASE-CASE from our instruments; the live path is guide MISSED (not formally cut) - note kill bar 7 fires only on a CUT, and the margin bar (<12.0% any qtr) has 40bp cushion. All consistent with our deliberately sub-coin-flip frozen 0.45 on the B2B bar.
